question: Should OpenClaw permanently expose memorySearch.queryInstructionTemplate and the associated Plugin SDK option/helper for opt-in model-ID-based query rewriting across OpenAI-style embedding providers?
rationale: Source review can establish correctness, but only maintainers can accept the long-term configuration naming, public SDK commitment, provider ownership, and model-template policy.

options.title: Sponsor Shared Opt-In
options.body: Approve the current default-false shared policy and reopen or retain the PR for ordinary landing review.

options.title: Require A Narrower Contract
options.body: Ask for a provider-scoped or differently typed configuration that avoids committing the current boolean and helper as the permanent public API.

options.title: Keep Formatting External
options.body: Decline a new OpenClaw configuration surface and require operators to format queries in their embedding server or proxy.

recommendation.title: Sponsor Shared Opt-In
recommendation.body: Approve the current default-false shared policy and reopen or retain the PR for ordinary landing review.
